english.title: Sex offender fail to notify police about return to U.K.
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being subject to notification requirements under Part 1 of the Sex Offenders Act 1997 who had left and subsequently returned to the United Kingdom, failed without reasonable excuse to comply with a requirement imposed by regulations made by the Secretary of State by virtue of Section 2(6D) of the Act, in that you

(A)_[failed to give a notice disclosing]_
(B)_[gave a notice which did not disclose]_
(C)_[gave a notice which you knew to be false disclosing]_

information, namely **(..SPECIFY..), prescribed by the regulations which about your return to the United Kingdom
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 3(1B)(a) and 3(1A) of the Sex Offenders Act 1997.
